theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ha_lsc_grad_norm_sq
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (L : Euclid n →L[ℝ] ℝ), ‖L‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin n, L (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 ∧ ∀ a : Fin n → ℝ, |∑ i : Fin n, L (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) * a i| ≤ ‖L‖ * Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin n, a i ^ 2)
